admission.justification: Reading the kept families again at every step, or reading a subject the cache holds, would multiply the requests of a walk with the number of families passed and would make stepping back slow where it is immediate. The mounted walk case counts the review requests of every press.

applicability: The requests of the mounted intent reviewer while the reader walks the family tree.
conditions: The walk is computed from the answers the workspace shows, in the render that shows them. It makes no request and stores nothing outside the mounted reviewer.
A kept family holds, whole, the answer it was last read from.
Folding the same answer again gives the same walk, so a render that finds nothing new stores nothing.
exclusions: The one read a kept family's continuation control makes when the reader uses it: it is the read of the selection of that family.
Server-side state, routes and response fields: none exists for the walked tree.
statement: Keeping the walked tree issues no request: a selection issues one review read for a subject the read cache does not hold and none for one it holds, and nothing is read for a kept family.
